[h2][b]What's next?[/b][/h2]

Hello dear community,

We have some exciting news regarding the development of our game!

Our plan is to launch the game in Early Access right after the final playtest. This upcoming final playtest is crucial for us. It will help us identify any remaining bugs and evaluate whether the game loop truly delivers the experience we want.

We have decided to add the missing content for Early Access, including the overworld.

Another focus is the complete overhaul of the classes. Our goal is to make them more unique and diverse. At the same time, we want to add a wider variety of abilities and talents to allow for more individual builds.

We look forward to your participation in the final playtest and are eager to hear your feedback!

Thank you for your support and stay tuned for more updates!


Dreameffect team

notes.title: Weekly Status Report
notes.content:
[h1][b]The open multiplayer playtest has ended. Thank you for your active participation.[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41443447/28e268bc861455ac9231f4d1fbaf675f67b6e1e5.png[/img]
We have received 91.7% positive feedback and are happy with the result, even though we had a lot of technical difficulties at the beginning. We are also aware that many players were forgiving because it was an early build.

[h3]What we learned from the feedback.[/h3]

[h2][b]PvE[/b][/h2]

[h3]Enemies tend to form large groups[/h3]
We have also noticed that some players simply want to solo and parry, but are unable to do so because the opponents are usually in larger groups. This is because the game is designed for 2 players. We have therefore decided to make solo play possible by adjusting the group sizes.

[h3]The game tends to be too easy and becomes even easier in the endgame[/h3]
We also think that the game has become too easy in co-op. We don't want to make the game more difficult, but we are planning to add Co-Op +. Here the player can increase the difficulty of Conquests and get better rewards for completing them.

[h3]The paths in the procedural world are not obvious[/h3]
We agree with this and will work on a solution.

[h3]Multiplayer experience generally good[/h3]
The overall multiplayer experience was generally well received. We are aware that we had some technical difficulties, especially in the beginning. There are still a few issues we need to work on.

[h3]Lost save files[/h3]
We want to work on the backup system for the save files and minimize the loss in case of corruption.

[h3]Cheater[/h3]
Duel Corp is a single player game with the option for multiplayer, cheats are allowed in offline mode. However, since there is PvP and co-op with random players, we want to detect cheaters and exclude them from multiplayer with random players.

[h3]More Content[/h3]
More content is planned, including more classes, weapons, talents, abilities, curses, objectives, story areas and new regions.

[h3]Problems with the key bindings[/h3]
There were players who suggested better input patterns. The input system has already been changed so that everyone can bind it as they wish.

[h2][b]PvP[/b][/h2]

[h3]▻ PvP will stay in the game
▻ PvP will be 1v1 only[/h3]

PvP was never really planned, but after trying it out, we decided to add 2v2. However, during the playtest we had technical difficulties and the latency was too extreme due to our network system. So we started a 1v1 test. Even though the connection is sometimes laggy, we want to keep it in the game.

[h3][b]Leaderboard[/b][/h3]
We would like to set up an in-game memorial for all top players who have achieved high rankings in the playtest.

notes.title: Release date delayed
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support and interest in our game.

We have to delay the release of Duel Corp, originally scheduled for Q1 2022 to Q2 2022. 

There are multiple reasons why we have to delay the release:
[list]
[*] The original release date was planned for the 2D version of the game. We need to rework the entire game from the ground up to make it 3D.
[*] We want to go through an alpha and a beta phase to get as much feedback as possible. We want to release a tested and complete game, even if it is an early access game.
[*] One of us two developers is still working on his master's thesis in parallel.
[/list]
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and hope for your understanding in this matter.
